tips.text: Finish and extract the mission after skipping a Candidate; quitting leaves that weapon in the pool.
Wait for the Treasurer on Pluto Hydra before you leave; he refunds the Zenith Crown you spent, so one Crown keeps the loop going.
Throw a Xoris at the Errant Specters and heavy attack to detonate it; even a 0-Forma one clears the Granum Void.
Open the Golden Hand far from extraction and walk out slowly; within about 200 m of it the Candidate never spawns.
Run the Candidate loop solo; squads raise the kill requirement and only the last player to hit her can Mercy.
Summon a Specter or your On-Call crew before the Void pulls you in; they follow you and do the killing.
Mercy her on a Magnetic frame, or Toxin for Viral on top of the innate Cold.
Skip a Heat progenitor; the Blast procs are mostly wasted on a beam.
Take whatever element you roll; an Elemental Vice swaps it later on a rank 40 weapon.
Bring a tanky build to the fight; Sisters of rank 4 and up spawn Spectralyst copies of your loadout.
Put Oull in slot 1 and test each revealed Requiem in slot 2; you finish by the fourth stab.
Run Survival, Defense or Excavation on her nodes for Hounds, then short missions to draw her out.
Fight her in a full squad to earn up to 4 Corrupted Holokeys instead of 1.
Bring a Railjack with real shields and hull mods, or do not host the fight.
Most players keep the first Glaxion they roll, add an Elemental Vice and stop.
Chasing 60% valence is the part players regret.
